title: Higher Education Support Amendment (Fair Study and Opportunity) Bill 2025
short_title: Higher Education Support Amendment (Fair Study and Opportunity) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would reduce maximum student contributions for higher education units classified as society and culture by moving them into a lower contribution category under higher education law.
It would transfer those subjects from the first contribution table item to the second, updating the entries for both grandfathered students and other students.
The amendments would cover units whose census dates fall on or after 1 January 2025, with the bill commencing the day after Royal Assent.
changes: Society and culture would be removed from the higher contribution category, including its grandfathered student reference.
The lower category's entry for non-grandfathered students would expressly include society and culture.
The corresponding lower-category entry for grandfathered students would also be amended to include those subjects.
summary.affected: Students taking society and culture units, including grandfathered students, and tertiary institutions setting their student contributions are affected.
